description: A large copper cauldron lies on its side on cobblestones, with embers, ash, ladles, a wooden-handled blade and a gold-trimmed felt cap scattered around it. Behind is smoke and fire, a domed mosque with minarets, and on the right two wheeled cannons with silhouetted figures in red fezzes. No bodies are visible. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with a faint mark in the lower right corner that is not readable text.
